kind: bug / Graph / Tensor method keyword signature
title: Tensor.amax/amin keyword arguments fail in Graph mode while ops controls work
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local Tensor.amax/Tensor.amin expose keepdims, initial, and where keyword parameters and forward them to the tensor operator registry.
MindSpore 2.9 local ops.amax/ops.amin accept the same keepdims and initial keywords and compile successfully in Graph mode on CPU.
MindSpore 2.9 local Graph standard_method.py defines amax(input, axis=None, keep_dims=False) and amin(input, axis=None, keep_dims=False), omitting initial and where.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: integer reductions with exact expected outputs are used.
Not an unsupported CPU kernel issue: direct ops.amax and ops.amin compile and run in Graph mode on the same CPU input.
The failure is localized to Graph parsing/lowering of the Tensor method keyword signature.
